**8B.10 Research Note: Srettha Thavisin in 2024**
**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning negative. He did move some of the stated program forward early in 2024, but the gains were partial and fragile. By the end of the period, he had not clearly become closer to a durable ideological, policy, or power-consolidation program once coalition fragility, implementation failures, and the August 14, 2024 court removal are counted.

**Closer by end**
- [Thailand’s cabinet approves $13.5 billion digital-wallet handout](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-23. Srettha turned a signature campaign promise into an approved state program, which is real movement toward his revealed domestic policy agenda even if the design was fiscally controversial. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.6, 8B.7, 8B.8
- [Thai ex-executive Pichai named finance minister, faces growth challenge](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thai-exexecutive-pichai-named-finance-minister-faces-growth-challenge-3401984) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-28. Appointing a former SET and Bank of Thailand board figure to Finance looks like a technocratic correction that could improve execution of the growth program. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.8, 8B.6
- [Thailand using formal policy channels to promote trade, investment, tourism, technology, and FTA improvement](https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/2078/iid/266801) - Thailand Public Relations Department, 2024-03-06. This is direct evidence of a pro-growth, pro-investment policy program being operationalized through official institutions rather than only rhetoric. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.4, 8B.6
- [Thailand-Sri Lanka sign free trade agreement](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailand-sri-lanka-sign-free-trade-agreement-3291876) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-02-03. Srettha used an FTA to advance rule-based commercial statecraft, which is a concrete step toward the revealed external-economic program. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.4, 8B.6
- [Thailand advances cross-border humanitarian pilot with Myanmar Red Cross and AHA Centre](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-03-26. The government used humanitarian institutions to respond to Myanmar spillover, preserving regional stability and giving Srettha a visible crisis-management gain. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9, 8B.8
- [Thailand joins ASEAN call for restraint, cessation of violence, humanitarian access, and civilian protection](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?menu=5d5bd3dc15e39c306002ab1c&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-04-18. This shows Srettha aligning Thailand with a de-escalatory regional line, supporting influence through diplomacy rather than coercion. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9
- [Srettha working relentlessly to solve Myanmar crisis](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2798697/thailand-working-relentlessly-to-solve-myanmar-crisis-srettha) - Bangkok Post, reporting Bloomberg News, 2024-05-24. Srettha publicly framed Thailand’s role as reducing spillover violence, which is evidence of a stabilizing foreign-policy posture that advances influence through restraint. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9
- [Victory: Same-sex marriage in Thailand](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/victory-same-sex-marriage-thailand) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-06-18. Marriage equality passed under his government, which is a genuine durable policy win that moved the rights program forward. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.4, 8B.6
- [Thailand’s $13 billion handout to include cash payments](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-part-of-13-billion-digital-wallet-stimulus-to-be-in-cash-3597164) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-03. The partial shift from a pure digital-wallet design to cash payments is the clearest late course correction, showing some adjustment after implementation trouble. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.8

**Farther from the goal / not durable**
- [Thai central bank holds key rate, defies government calls for cuts](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-10. Repeated pressure on the Bank of Thailand suggests Srettha was still trying to force short-term growth relief rather than building a more disciplined, durable policy regime. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.8, 8B.6
- [Forty senators seek PM’s dismissal over cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/forty-thai-senators-seek-pms-dismissal-over-cabinet-appointment/2089532/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-05-17. The Pichit appointment triggered formal challenge, showing that politically connected staffing had already become a liability rather than a consolidating move. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.8, 8B.6
- [Thai court says PM Srettha violated ethics in cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-says-pm-srettha-violated-rules-on-ethics-in-cabinet-appointment/2222960/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-14. The ethics ruling and his dismissal are the strongest evidence that he ended the period farther from durable power consolidation than he started. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9, 8B.8
- [Thailand’s prime minister removed by Constitutional Court](https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/48/iid/315614) - Public Relations Department, 2024-08-14. His premiership ended through institutional removal, not consolidation, which is a clear negative for regime-durability claims. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9
- [Thailand’s flagship handout hits snags and expert criticism](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html) - Reuters via Yahoo News, 2024-08-01. The main domestic signature program still had registration delays and fiscal-risk criticism late in the period, so it was not yet a stable achievement. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.6, 8B.8, 8B.7
- [Thailand | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand) - Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, 2024-06-17. Media freedom remained constrained and self-censorship persisted, which undercuts any claim that his governing environment had become more secure, legitimate, or durable. QIDs: 8B.10, 7B.1, 7B.2
- [Thai journalists arrested for news coverage of anti-royal graffiti](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thai-journalists-arrested-news-coverage-054141721.html) - Reuters via Yahoo News, 2024-02-13. The arrests show a continuing coercive information environment, which weakens the case that the regime had become more stable by tolerating scrutiny. QIDs: 8B.10, 7B.1, 7B.2
- [Thailand’s leaders shun UN human rights chief](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/06/thailands-leaders-shun-un-human-rights-chief) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-06-06. Avoiding external scrutiny is evidence against durable institutional confidence and against a stronger, more legitimate governing coalition. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.9, 7B.1

**Context that tempers the judgment**
- [World Bank July 2024 monitor](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/thailand/publication/temjuly2024) - World Bank, 2024-07-03. The economy was only in modest recovery, with fiscal pressures rising; that means Srettha was working against a weak inherited baseline, so some improvement in outputs does not translate into full program success. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.7
- [Bank of Thailand MPC statement](https://www.bot.or.th/en/news-and-media/news/news-20240612.html) - Bank of Thailand, 2024-06-12. Growth was slow and structurally constrained, which limits how far any 2024 prime minister could realistically move the program in one year. QIDs: 8B.10, 8B.7

**Search gap**
- I found strong public evidence on policy moves, coalition friction, and the August 2024 dismissal, but not internal cabinet scorecards, private strategy memos, or formal implementation dashboards. So this is a public-evidence judgment: it can show visible progress and visible failure, but not the full internal decision process behind either.
